requirements.title: Program execution is asynchronous execution of a fixed number of images
requirements.definition: Execution of a program consists of asynchronous execution of a fixed number of images; each image has its own execution state and identified image index.

pending.fixed-number-of-images: OUT OF SCOPE: observing image count or image creation requires image execution support excluded by user decision.

pending.image-index-range: OUT OF SCOPE: observing image indices requires image/team execution support excluded by user decision.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinct sentinels before the observed action, use exact integer or logical results, and avoid compiler-message wording or processor-dependent process status values.

requirements.title: Teams are ordered image sets with parent and sibling-team number relationships
requirements.definition: A team is an ordered set of images with the specified initial-team, parent-team, and team-number relationships.

pending.initial-team: OUT OF SCOPE: observing the initial team requires team/image execution support excluded by user decision.

pending.team-number-among-siblings: OUT OF SCOPE: observing sibling team numbers requires team/image execution support excluded by user decision.

requirements.title: The current team controls image index and coindexing context
requirements.definition: Each image has a current team, initially the initial team, changed by CHANGE TEAM and END TEAM; image indices and coindexing are relative to that team except as specified.
